stories.title: Weekly Budget Check
stories.situation: I am preparing my weekly budget on Sunday evening
stories.motivation: see how much I have spent so far this month by category
stories.outcome: decide where to cut back before the month ends
acceptance_criteria: Spending view shows current month transactions grouped by category
Each category displays total spent and remaining budget
Categories exceeding budget are visually distinguished
Tapping a category shows individual transactions
View loads within 2 seconds on mobile
Date range is fixed to current calendar month
